title: Police seek suspect in Edmonton kidnapping
article: Police are on the lookout for an Alberta man wanted in connection to a robbery and kidnapping in Edmonton earlier this month.
Lyle Cory Crane, 38, of St. Paul is one of four suspects who robbed and kidnapped an Edmonton man on Jan.13, Two Hills RCMP said.
Three suspects were arrested at the time, but police said Crane remains at large. He is wanted on a warrant, and is considered armed and dangerous.

Crane is described as five-foot-eight, weighs 165 pounds and has black hair and brown eyes. He was last seen driving a stolen blue/purple, two-door, 1995 Toyota Tercel, with a welded metal bracket for attaching a tow bar on the front bumper.

Police were advising the public not to approach Crane. Anyone with information about Crane's whereabouts was asked to call Two Hills RCMP at 780-624-6677. Anonymous tips can be sent to Crime Stoppers at 1-800-222-8477 or online at tipsubmit.com.
